messages:
Olivia Park: Noticed tenant X firing ~7 alerts/min on an SLO. Pages are cascading into multiple rotations. Suggestion: a notify-level damping policy to reduce fanout temporarily. Thoughts on API and Console UX?
Zach Lee: Damping not full mute. Token-bucket approach sounds good: allow short bursts, throttle sustained noise.
Priya Nair: Console UX: show a "Noise mitigation" suggestion card on the SLO page with an estimate (pages avoided) and a dry-run button. Make it clear suppression ≠ changing the SLO.
Jamir Simon: API idea: separate resource signal_policy linked to slo_id rather than embedding in notify_policy. Keeps evaluator simpler and backward compatible.
Olivia Park: Agreed. Console could create the signal_policy via one-click from suggestion card. Add explanation tooltip for operators.
Zach Lee: Telemetry: even when suppressed emit suppressed_count, suppression_intervals, and suppression_reason tags. Also record attempted fallback deliveries.
Priya Nair: Visual: timeline overlay with grey bands for suppression, hover shows start/end and pages avoided. CTA to run dry-run over selected window.
Jamir Simon: Minimal config sketch:
```
signal_policy:
 id: "sp-..."
 linked_slo: "slo-..."
 mode: "token_bucket"
 rate_per_min: 30
 burst: 45
 window_seconds: 600
 emit_metrics: true
```
Olivia Park: Rollout: 1) suggestion-only analytics in staging for 2 weeks; 2) pilot opt-in behind feature flag; 3) staged ramp with auto-rollback if false-negative ratio > 0.5%.
deploy-bot: feature-flag "slo-noise-damping" enabled in staging for pilot tenants.
Zach Lee: For simulations reuse sampling pipeline; return CI on pages-avoided estimates. Keep sim cheap for high-volume tenants via approximation.
Priya Nair: I'll draft UI copy and mocks for the suggestion card and explainer modal.
Jamir Simon: I'll own the API compatibility notes and audit stream for suppressed decisions.
Olivia Park: I'll assemble an RFC (API, console mocks, telemetry schema, rollout checklist). Target: RFC by Tuesday EOD.
